title: Energy Extraction from Rotating Charged Black Holes in Kalb-Ramond Gravity
summary: This work presents a comprehensive study of energy extraction via the Comisso-Asenjo magnetic reconnection mechanism from rotating charged black holes in the context of Kalb-Ramond (KR) gravity.
